text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the race unfolding as planned, Satono 
Crown was confident of victory. However, 
Duramente hung on relentlessly with an 
astonishing late burst of speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her calculations thrown off, Satono Crown 
suffered defeat. Duramente also missed out 
on 1st place, but her late charge was 
menacingly fierce.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just one month left until the Japanese 
Derby. During that time, Satono Crown 
decided to devise a strategy against 
Duramente.
